summary.headline: The Southborough Planning Board opened a major public hearing on a proposed Costco wholesale store and fuel facility at 21 Coslin Drive.
summary.summary: The Southborough Planning Board held a regular meeting on September 28, 2026, featuring an extensive presentation and initial review of Costco Wholesale's proposed 167,000-square-foot warehouse and 15-pump fueling facility at 21 Coslin Drive. The board also reviewed updates to the two-family dwelling zoning bylaw warrant article, continued a public hearing for 154 Turnpike Road, and discussed master plan implementation goals.

topics.title: Two-family dwelling zoning bylaw update
topics.summary: The board discussed minor text cleanup and redline changes for the proposed two-family dwelling zoning bylaw warrant article, including removing redundant terms.
key_details: Removed redundant words ('townhouse' and 'duplex') due to Scribner errors.
Corrected redundant language across district amendments regarding lot sizes.
topics.outcome: Continued public hearing to October 17, 2026 at 6:45 PM.
topics.why_it_matters: Changes to the two-family zoning bylaw affect housing development rules and density across town zoning districts.

topics.title: 154 Turnpike Road site plan modification
topics.summary: The board addressed a continuance request for the public hearing regarding non-compliance modifications and major site plan approval for 154 Turnpike Road.
key_details: Applicant requested a continuation without testimony.
New hearing date set for October 19, 2026.
topics.outcome: Public hearing continued to October 19, 2026 at 6:45 PM.

topics.title: 21 Coslin Drive - Costco Wholesale site plan & special permits
topics.summary: Representatives for Costco Wholesale presented a major site plan, low-impact development special permit, and highway major retail special permit for a 167,000-square-foot warehouse and 15-pump fueling facility at 21 Coslin Drive.
key_details: Site location: 21 Coslin Drive (26.12 acres in the Industrial Park district and Westborough).
Proposed use: 167,000 sq ft Costco warehouse with 895 parking spaces and a 15-pump fueling facility (30 fueling positions).
Includes stormwater management upgrades, underground detention, and 36-foot 6-inch lighting poles.
Traffic studies, trip generation, and Route 9/Crystal Pond Road mitigation were reviewed.
topics.outcome: Continued public hearing to October 19, 2026 at 6:30 PM.
topics.why_it_matters: A major commercial development of this scale will significantly impact traffic, local tax base, commercial services, and infrastructure on Route 9.

topics.title: Master Plan Implementation Committee update
topics.summary: The board received an update on master plan implementation committee goals, file organization, and future committee alignment toward 2030 master plan targets.
key_details: Discussed organizing documents and tracking subcommittees.
Reviewed coordination needs with town departments and future meeting schedules.
topics.outcome: No formal action taken; discussion only.

votes.motion: To continue the public hearing for the two-family dwelling zoning bylaw to October 17, 2026 at 6:45 PM
To continue the public hearing for 154 Turnpike Road to October 19, 2026 at 6:45 PM
To continue the public hearing for 21 Coslin Drive (Costco) to October 19, 2026 at 6:30 PM

public_comment.summary: A resident spoke about traffic impacts, site access, and landscaping/pollinator plant requirements related to the Costco proposal.
